title: [Bug] Windows CLI text window automatically scrolls up to older messages while typing.

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly reports a platform-specific bug where typing in the CLI text window on Windows (win32) causes the viewport to automatically scroll up to older messages instead of staying at the active prompt.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: This issue involves terminal rendering, viewport scroll synchronization, and input state management during React/Ink redraws on Windows (win32). Platform-specific terminal bugs require cross-environment testing and validation, placing this in the MEDIUM effort category.

summary.problem: On Windows (win32), typing in the CLI text input prompt causes the terminal window to automatically scroll up to older messages rather than remaining anchored at the bottom prompt line.
summary.root_cause: When characters are typed into the InputPrompt component, state updates trigger Ink re-renders. Visual row and scroll index calculations in InputPrompt and ScrollableList trigger scroll adjustments that shift the viewport offset upwards to older scrollback items when typing.
summary.context: The interactive CLI relies on Ink rendering and text-buffer state tracking. Viewport scroll calculations in InputPrompt.tsx and ScrollableList.tsx need to maintain stable scroll anchoring at the active input line.

steps: Inspect cursor visual row calculations and scrollToIndex logic inside InputPrompt.tsx during text buffer updates.
Ensure viewport auto-scrolling logic keeps the active cursor row visible without jumping upward to historical messages during typing.
Verify terminal line wrapping and viewport bounds synchronization for Windows terminal compatibility in interactiveCli.tsx.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When typing text into the input prompt on Windows CLI, the viewport remains pinned to the active prompt cursor line and does not scroll up to historical messages.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in InputPrompt.test.tsx simulating typing keypresses with historical message entries present.
Assert that the viewport scrollTop remains steady and does not scroll up to previous messages during text input.
